coverImage.caption: Cover In a healthy aquatic environment, turtle eggs incubated at a low temperature develop into males with a masculinized brain transcriptomic profile. However, when exposed to bisphenol A, turtles who should otherwise be male demonstrate a feminized brain transcriptomic profile. For details see Manshack LK, Conard CM, Bryan SJ, Deem SL, Holliday DK, Bivens NJ, Givan SA, Rosenfeld CS. Transcriptomic alterations in the brain of painted turtles (Chrysemys picta) developmentally exposed to bisphenol A or ethinyl estradiol. Physiol Genomics (10.1152/physiolgenomics.00103.2016).
